name: Turkish Get-Up with Pause
description: The Turkish get-up performed with deliberate pauses at each transition point to increase time under tension and improve positional awareness. The pauses expose weaknesses in each phase and build comprehensive strength throughout the entire movement chain.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Turkish Get-Up with Pause in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Turkish Get-Up with Pause.
steps: Step 1: Begin lying with kettlebell pressed overhead in one hand.
Step 2: Move through each phase of the Turkish get-up.
Step 3: Pause for 3 seconds at each transition point: roll, elbow, hand, kneeling, standing.
Step 4: Reverse all phases with same pauses to return to floor.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Kettlebell stays directly overhead at all times
